prompt:
You are helping a small vision model watch a first-person video stream.
The user asked: "{query}"

Write {n} short visual cues (each under 15 words) describing what the CAMERA WOULD SEE
at the exact moment the user should be notified. Rules:
- concrete, visible things only (objects, hand actions, text on screen), not intentions
- each cue should appear only when the response is due, not before
- cover different viewpoints or sub-steps of the same event

Return JSON: {{"cues": ["...", "..."]}}
You are also shown {k} frames from the video, one per second, from the {where}. Use them to make the cues specific to THIS scene (the
actual people, objects and setting you can see). But describe what will look DIFFERENT at the moment the user should be notified, not
the scene as it already looks in these frames.
